title: AI and self-regulated learning: connecting support, learner readiness and independent performance
title_zh: AI与自我调节学习：连接学习支持、学习者基础与独立表现
description: Connect evidence on AI-supported self-regulated learning, learner readiness and programming environments to design phase-sensitive studies.
description_zh: 综合AI自我调节学习元分析、编程准实验与智能体综述，连接学习阶段、学习者基础和独立表现的评价。

title: Agents in programming education: connecting learner readiness, collaboration and learning design
title_zh: 智能体与编程教育：连接学习者基础、协作过程与教学设计
description: Read evidence on AI agents, ChatGPT learner readiness and immersive programming to design studies of collaboration and programming learning.
description_zh: 连接AI智能体协作编程、ChatGPT使用基础与沉浸式课堂证据，明确成绩、自我效能和认知负荷的评价。

title: Generative AI literacy and adoption: connecting learner capability, intention and educational context
title_zh: 生成式AI素养与采用：连接学习能力、采纳意愿与教育情境
description: Connect AI literacy, ChatGPT adoption intentions, task effectiveness and education policy through complementary empirical and synthesis studies.
description_zh: 综合ChatGPT采纳意愿、编程任务效果、AIGC教育综述与政策研究，明确能力、意愿和教育情境之间的研究问题。
seo_title: AI Literacy, GenAI Adoption and fsQCA
